name: Crunchem Pizzy Masala
ingredients_raw: POTATO (88%), EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALMOLEIN), SUGAR EDIBLE COMMON SALT, DEHYDRATED VEGETABLE POWDER 0.6% (ONION, GARLIC, TOMATO), MILK SOLIDS (WHEY (0.1%) SPICES & CONDIMENTS (CHILLI, PEPPER, OREGANO), PARSLEY ANTICAKING AGENT (INS 551, INS 414), NATURAL & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (PIZZA). PROPRIETARY FOOD POTATO WAFERS INDIAN SNACKS & SAVOURIES ALLERGEN ADVICE: CONTAINS MILK SOLID
